payload.title: wake push: send a local space into a running instance

payload.text: Recency first read only `updated`, so status.md — which is derived and stamps `generated` — stayed stale through a full push. Caught by pushing into a real instance rebuilt from an older commit and re-reading the prose, not by the unit tests, which had agreed with the bug.

payload.reason: Shipped with 11 tests. Verified instance-to-instance: a deployment rebuilt at the pre-catch-up commit went from 9 issues to 22, logs merged, status prose refreshed.
